title: Atlas free research queries, presentation, provenance and common result contracts

max_source_age_seconds.description: Maximum age of the oldest source retrieval/check used, including inputs. Does not force refresh.
max_source_age_seconds.title: Max Source Age Seconds

min_observation_date.description: Minimum date for the latest usable selected output observation or period end, not its publication time.
min_observation_date.title: Min Observation Date

allow_missing.description: Permit Atlas-marked unavailable/ambiguous cells, null value/primary amount fields and partial coverage; optional metadata is not certified.
allow_missing.title: Allow Missing

allow_derived.description: Permit output/dependency records marked as derived.
allow_derived.title: Allow Derived

allow_truncated.description: Permit explicit record, archive or footnote truncation. A fixed upstream window alone is not truncation.
allow_truncated.title: Allow Truncated

ResponseOptions.description: Presentation only: does not expand upstream retrieval or relax coverage.
ResponseOptions.title: ResponseOptions

quote_currency.description: Units of quote currency per one base currency; must differ from base_currency.

query.description: One dataset-specific ResearchQuery from atlas_research_catalog. Queries are validated independently; invalid queries produce per-item errors.
query.title: Query

ResearchResult.description: Common envelope; dataset-specific records and metadata remain extensible.
ResearchResult.title: ResearchResult
